items.title: Nicki Parrott interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 2, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe and I’m happy to have my guest Nicki Parrott here today

ctx.x: Nicki was interviewed via Zoom on June 2, 2020, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and I’m happy to have my guest Nicki Parrott here today, remotely unfortunately, but I did think it was worth gathering some stories for the Fillius Jazz Archive about how musicians and artists are making out these days. And we’ve seen some very upbeat examples of how you’re making out with your new online adventure and really enjoying Chez Nicki Jams.

Thank you. I’m so glad you are. I’ve had some really nice feedback from it because it feels like an escape but it’s also supporting a good cause, the World Central Kitchen, and they are needed right now. They are world-wide. They were helping in Australia when the bush fires were in Australia in January of this year and they’re helping out during the pandemic, you know, countless meals everyday, hoping to keep restaurants open to cook the meals for families. So that’s nice. It’s sort of — it started because we…

items.title: Nicki Parrott interviewed by Monk Rowe. Utica, New York, November 6, 2010 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Interviewer introduces himself as Monk Rowe; Interviewee responds politely but no personal relationship is described.

ctx.x: Nicki was interviewed in Utica, New York on November 6, 2010 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and I’m off-camera, but I’m very pleased to have Nicki Parrott here as a guest for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. Welcome back to Utica.
Thank you. Always good to be here.
